## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 18, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Paul Lapouge Dalbavie_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Much too expensive application which offers you a first month for 6€ but the next one what was my surprise to realize that the monthly subscription was then more than 70€, of course if I had not looked in detail on the Play Store it is impossible to know Despite it being a good application despite the recurring bugs, it is much too expensive for what it is"
            2. _Liam Els_, Sep 28, 2026, 2/5: "great concept, and interface, but very buggy still. name brand food don't show in list, searching foods like egg, I have to scroll down 20 items to find a plain egg instead of options like congee egg and omelet, after using it at some point the search box just glitch out too, moving my cursur after every letter. And when creating a workout, the numbers don't fit in the test boxes, they get cut off."
            3. _Mc Marcuzz_, Aug 21, 2026, 2/5: "2/5 the app. I have been using it for more than two months. I don't know how to understand the rank system very well, you never go up, it's as if it will invite you to pay for the application so you can go up. bad experience, many Bugs, the app windows when you touch to add series, 8 out of 10 times, overlap and do not let you see anything. sometimes the functions do not respond. It has potential, but I'm going to give up using it."
